parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-3] MsgGrantDelegateAuthorization grants a delegate authorization
to a grantee on behalf of a corporation.

On the group-proposal path the corporation's policy account executes the
message and `signer` equals `corporation`; only AUTHZ-CHECK-5 then applies.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-10] MsgGrantSponsorship declares the budget a sponsor corporation
pays for another corporation. Executed by the sponsor's policy account
through a group proposal.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-4] MsgRevokeDelegateAuthorization revokes a delegate
authorization for a grantee on behalf of a corporation. Same signer
semantics as MsgGrantDelegateAuthorization (see above).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-11] MsgRevokeSponsorship ends a sponsorship on behalf of the
sponsor corporation. On the group-proposal path `delegate` equals
`corporation`.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
signatures required by gogoproto.

corporation.description: corporation is the policy_address of the corporation granting the authorization.

signer.description:
signer is a delegate authorized by corporation, or corporation itself
on the group-proposal path.

grantee.description: grantee is the account that receives the authorization from corporation.

msg_types.description:
msg_types is the list of VPR delegable message types for which
authorization is granted.

expiration.description: expiration is the optional timestamp after which the authorization expires.

authz_spend_limit.description: authz_spend_limit is the optional maximum spendable amount.

authz_spend_limit_period.description:
authz_spend_limit_period is the optional reset period for
authz_spend_limit.

with_feegrant.description: with_feegrant indicates whether to also grant a fee allowance.

feegrant_spend_limit.description:
feegrant_spend_limit is the optional maximum fee amount. Ignored if
with_feegrant is false.

feegrant_spend_limit_period.description:
feegrant_spend_limit_period is the optional reset period for
feegrant_spend_limit. Ignored if with_feegrant is false.

verana.de.v1.MsgGrantDelegateAuthorizati.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-3] MsgGrantDelegateAuthorization grants a delegate authorization
to a grantee on behalf of a corporation.

On the group-proposal path the corporation's policy account executes the
message and `signer` equals `corporation`; only AUTHZ-CHECK-5 then applies.

MsgGrantDelegateAuthorizationResponse defines the response for
MsgGrantDelegateAuthorization.

corporation.description: corporation is the policy_address of the sponsor corporation.

sponsored_corporation_id.description: sponsored_corporation_id is the id of the corporation to sponsor.

msg_types.description: msg_types are the covered paying message types; empty means all of them.

spend_limit.description: spend_limit is the maximum operation funds paid per cycle.

period.description: period is the cycle length for spend_limit.

expiration.description:
expiration is the end of the sponsorship, or the end of the first cycle
when period is set.

covers_fees.description:
covers_fees indicates the sponsor also pays the network fees of the
sponsored corporation.

fee_spend_limit.description:
fee_spend_limit is the maximum network fees paid per period, or in total
when period is unset. Ignored if covers_fees is false.

verana.de.v1.MsgGrantSponsorship.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-10] MsgGrantSponsorship declares the budget a sponsor corporation
pays for another corporation. Executed by the sponsor's policy account
through a group proposal.

verana.de.v1.MsgGrantSponsorshipResponse.description: MsgGrantSponsorshipResponse defines the response for MsgGrantSponsorship.

corporation.description: corporation is the policy_address of the corporation revoking the authorization.

signer.description:
signer is a delegate authorized by corporation, or corporation itself
on the group-proposal path.

grantee.description: grantee is the account whose authorization is being revoked.

verana.de.v1.MsgRevokeDelegateAuthorizat.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-4] MsgRevokeDelegateAuthorization revokes a delegate
authorization for a grantee on behalf of a corporation. Same signer
semantics as MsgGrantDelegateAuthorization (see above).

MsgRevokeDelegateAuthorizationResponse defines the response for
MsgRevokeDelegateAuthorization.

corporation.description: corporation is the policy_address of the sponsor corporation.

delegate.description:
delegate is the signer: an authorized delegate, or the corporation's
policy_address itself on the group-proposal path.

sponsored_corporation_id.description: sponsored_corporation_id is the id of the sponsored corporation.

verana.de.v1.MsgRevokeSponsorship.description:
[MOD-DE-MSG-11] MsgRevokeSponsorship ends a sponsorship on behalf of the
sponsor corporation. On the group-proposal path `delegate` equals
`corporation`.

verana.de.v1.MsgRevokeSponsorshipRespons.description: MsgRevokeSponsorshipResponse defines the response for MsgRevokeSponsorship.

verana.de.v1.MsgType.description:
MsgType enumerates the delegable messages of the VPR. Numbers are stable and
only ever appended to.
